observations: Photo 0: A used automatic transmission gearbox assembly on the ground; label/plate visible but not readable enough to confirm exact model.
Photo 1: Close-up of the bellhousing/torque-converter side; internal ring/plate visible; no clear damage shown in the photo.
Photo 2: Side view of the transmission housing; no clear cracks visible, but condition is not fully verifiable from photos.

claims.claim: Transmissions Gearbox M278 1282 OEM G63, Mercedes transmission gearbox.
claims.evidence: The photos show a Mercedes-style transmission housing, but the exact 'M278 1282' / 'G63' identifiers are not readable/confirmable from the provided images.
No running/test video, no diagnostic printout, and no clear proof of operation in the photos.
No import documents, shipping marks, or Belgium sourcing evidence visible in the photos.

claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: Photos cannot confirm internal mileage, whether it was opened, or whether it has 'no knock' under load.

risks.risk: Wrong transmission variant/fitment (different Mercedes gearbox codes, bellhousing/TC differences) leading to non-fit or immediate failure.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the transmission identification code/label (gearbox code plate) and the VIN/engine code it matches; also request a short video showing the exact code plate close-up.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: not guaranteed to match/fit and treated as a used gearbox with unknown compatibility (i.e., not working/needs overhaul risk).

risks.risk: Internal condition not proven (torque converter, clutches/solenoids, valve body) despite 'tested'.
risks.proof: Request a diagnostic scan report (live data + DTCs) from the vehicle it was tested on, or a video of it engaging through all gears (P-R-N-D) with no abnormal noises.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: not proven working; assume overhaul/repair may be needed.

risks.risk: Leakage or contamination (ATF leaks, metal debris) not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Request close-up photos of the pan area, drain plug area, and any wetness; plus a short clip showing the gearbox after wiping/cleaning to confirm no fresh leaks.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: may leak/needs reseal.

risks.risk: Physical damage not obvious (housing cracks, mounting points, damaged connectors) could affect installation.
risks.proof: Request photos of all mounting ears, connector ports, and the full perimeter of the bellhousing; include a straight-on shot of the connector side.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: installation may require parts/repairs.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the gearbox code/ID plate (the exact code that determines compatibility).
Video proof of operation: start + engage through gears (P-R-N-D) with sound (no knock) and show the shifter/gear engagement.
Diagnostic scan report from the test vehicle (DTCs/live data) or a mechanic’s test sheet.
Photos of the transmission pan/drain plug area and connector ports (all sides), plus confirmation of no fresh ATF leaks after wiping.
response.reason: The photos show a used Mercedes-style automatic transmission, but the exact gearbox code/model (needed to price correctly and ensure fitment) is not readable, and the seller’s 'tested/working/no knock/low mileage/never opened' claims are not provable from photos alone.
